title: DECSET 2031 — Color scheme updates (dark/light)
summary: CSI ? 2031 h asks the terminal to send OSC 21 (color scheme change) notifications when the system switches between dark and light mode. CSI ? 2031 l disables them.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 2031 h Color scheme change notifications.

gotchas: When enabled, the terminal emits OSC 21 ; dark or OSC 21 ; light on a scheme change.
Lets TUIs adapt their palette without polling.
Support is growing but not universal; fall back to querying with OSC 11/10.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 2031 render as byte-exact CSI ? 2031 h/l sequences.
